type Prefix<T extends unknown[]> = [string?, ...T];
const missing: Prefix<[number]> = ["x"];
const fixedLength: Prefix<[number]>["length"] = 1;

type Frozen<T extends readonly unknown[]> = readonly [...T];
function write(fixed: Frozen<number[]>): void {
  fixed[0] = 1;
}
function optional(tuple: [string?, ...number[]]): void {
  const [first] = tuple;
  first.toUpperCase();
}
